title: R-305 夜間跨行轉帳規則:時間窗改半開區間
description: R-305 例行維護:時間窗由 BETWEEN 改為半開區間,順手整理閾值行。邏輯不變。

files.full_content:
-- R-305: 夜間跨行轉帳大額異常(超過 200000 通報)
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND t.is_interbank = TRUE
  AND t.currency = 'TWD'
  AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.tx_time) < 6
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) >= 200000;

_seeded_issues: 埋雷:HAVING 由 > 被改成 >=,與 specs/R-305.md 需求項目4「超過=不含=>」不符;
邊界案例(夜間累計恰 200000)會被誤報 → 執行驗證應抓到(仲裁判 SQL 錯 → major)
